# AT-Switch v3.15.1

发布日期 / Release date: 2026-10-03

## 本次更新

- 修复百度搭子（DuMate）切换后的配置校验：核对账号级 opencode.jsonc 的默认模型、轻量模型和全部原生别名，避免旧路由或缺失别名被误报为切换成功。
- 校验服务商地址、凭据、真实模型 ID 与固定模型请求头，覆盖已有会话和制品校验使用的别名。
- 设置页读取安装包的实际版本与当前运行平台，修复旧版本号和平台信息显示。

升级后选择百度搭子、刷新状态并重新应用目标模型。重启前保存工作。直连仍需 OpenAI Chat Completions；其他协议通过本地代理转换。切换账号后重新刷新并应用配置。切换成功表示配置校验通过，访问结果仍需通过真实请求确认。

## Changes

- Verify every native DuMate model alias in the effective account override, including default and small models, so missing aliases or stale routes no longer report success.
- Validate the provider URL, credential, real model ID, and fixed-model header for aliases used by existing conversations and artifact validation.
- Read the packaged version and current runtime platform in Settings.

After upgrading, refresh DuMate status and reapply the target model. Save work before restarting. Direct mode requires OpenAI Chat Completions; use the local proxy for other protocols. Refresh and reapply after switching accounts. Verify actual access with a real request.

## 已知依赖问题 / Known dependency issues

本版本的 Windows / macOS CI 已通过，但 Rust 依赖审计未通过。冻结安装包使用的 `rustls 0.23.42` 命中 [RUSTSEC-2026-0285](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0285)（CVSS 5.3，中等级）：TLS 1.3 可能接受加密层级不正确的握手消息。上游说明握手内容仍经过认证，网络中间人无法借此修改或完成握手，但异常对端发送的部分明文握手消息可能不被拒绝。上游修复版本为 `0.23.45`；本次冻结包不包含该修复。

审计还报告 `proc-macro-error` 及五项 `unic-*` 间接依赖已停止维护。这些告警已记录；本次发布保留原安装包及审计失败状态，不代表依赖问题已经修复。

Windows and macOS CI passed, but the Rust dependency audit failed. The frozen packages use `rustls 0.23.42`, affected by [RUSTSEC-2026-0285](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0285) (moderate, CVSS 5.3). Rustls may accept TLS 1.3 handshake messages at the wrong encryption level. The upstream advisory states that the handshake remains authenticated, so an on-path attacker cannot use this to alter or complete it. The fix is in `0.23.45` and is not included in these packages. The audit also flags six unmaintained transitive dependencies. This release does not claim those findings are resolved.
